reconcileDrift: The acceptance test handoff identified a concrete release blocker: all production ScreenComponents are backed only by EmptyScreenDataManager because no data-backed ScreenDataManager implementation exists. Domain engines and LocalDatabase are available and compiled; this assignment bridges them without changing UI or platform entrypoints.
goal: Implement the production data-backed ScreenDataManager for core AppSpec flows using LocalDatabase, SproutPaceCatalog and pure domain engines. Watches must expose stable IDs/resource keys and real persisted state; commands must validate typed arguments, preserve immutable snapshots/history, be idempotent by contract, and return one flat Result boundary. Add in-memory SQLDelight integration evidence for every listed core AC surface.
acceptanceCriteria: No production root path requires EmptyScreenDataManager for core catalog/setup/batch/plan/Today flows.
All sixteen ScreenId watches return deterministic snapshots derived from real database/catalog/settings state, with stable IDs and TextKey values rather than localized strings.
Core save/update/lifecycle/planning/Today/close commands validate typed arguments, call the appropriate pure engine and persist atomically through LocalDatabase.
Unknown operations or malformed arguments fail explicitly and never mutate state.
Duplicate command deduplication is compatible with Store-level exactly-once behavior and persisted entities keep immutable recipe/tray/zone snapshots.
Integration tests exercise every listed core AC through ProductionScreenDataManager and an in-memory SQLDelight database.
No UI, platform, ledger or external service changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
